name: STRAC
fix_description: Function 0x4a75084c performs a 1:1 token swap (transferFrom arg2 of tokenIn, transfer arg2 of tokenOut) without any price/rate calculation. It assumes all tokens are equal value. Attacker deposits a worthless/fake token and withdraws a valuable token at the same amount. Fix: implement proper pricing mechanism or oracle-based exchange rate.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very short, direct drain: call the vulnerable contract with a crafted selector, abuse a fake transferFrom that always returns true, then dump the received tokens to the LP. It relies on an obvious unsafe external token interaction / missing return-value verification pattern and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning.
